player_prompt.intro:
E te faʻaalia i le taʻaloga o numera o Countdown!
Faʻamoemoe: Faʻaopoopo numera i le faʻaaogaina o +, -, *, / e oo atu i le target.
Faʻatonuga o gaioiga: [i j op] i le va o i, j o faʻasino ma op o le gaioiga.
Faʻataʻitaʻiga: [0 2 *] faʻaopoopo numera i le faʻasino 0 ma numera i le faʻasino 2.
Totoʻa gaioiga e tatau ona i ai se faʻaiʻuga e le o toe faʻaopoopo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid action format. Use `[i j op]` where i,j are indices and op is +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Faʻailoga le aoga. E tatau ona ese ma i totonu o le 0-{max_index} vaega
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Faʻagaioiga le saʻo (vaevaega i se zero po o ni taunuuga e lē integer)

outcome.win: E lelei tele! Ua maua le sini tonu: {target}
outcome.no_moves: E leʻi i ai mafatiaga. Faʻaiʻuga sili: {best_value} (target: {target})
outcome.turn_limit: Uiga o mafatiaga o loʻo faʻaauau. Faʻaiʻuga sili: {best_value} (target: {target})
